throughline.zh: 新加坡公布 HBM 封裝與半導體設備廠里程碑，台灣和馬來西亞則更新電力設備、機房代管及製程材料進度。
throughline.en: Singapore reported HBM packaging and tool facility milestones, while Taiwan and Malaysia disclosed developments in power equipment, colocation and process materials.

title.zh: 新加坡 HBM 封裝及設備製造
title.en: Singapore HBM packaging and equipment manufacturing

summary.zh: 美光於 11 月 19 日將首台 HBM 製程設備移入新廠無塵室，預計 2027 年初產出。KLA 於 11 月 20 日啟用宏茂橋 22B 廠房，新增 21 萬平方英尺；兩案已完成的工程里程碑與未來量產、聘僱目標分開呈現。
summary.en: Micron moved its first HBM packaging tool into a Singapore cleanroom on November 19, while KLA opened its new 210,000-square-foot Ang Mo Kio building on November 20. Completed milestones are distinct from future output and hiring plans.

title.zh: 台灣電力設備訂單及公用電力預算
title.en: Taiwan power equipment orders and utility financing

summary.zh: 亞力法說揭露在手訂單 130 億元，涉及半導體、資料中心與電網。立法院另通過撥補台電 711 億元的追加預算，12 月費率仍待審議。
summary.en: Allis reported a NT$13 billion backlog spanning fabs, data centers and the grid. Separately, Taiwan passed a supplementary budget with NT$71.1 billion for Taipower, with December rates pending review.

title.zh: 半導體製程材料、封裝及光互連進度
title.en: Chip process materials, packaging and optical interconnects

summary.zh: 晶呈科技揭露第三季特氣出貨與玻璃通孔產線規劃，南寶表示半導體用膠已供貨。經濟日報另報導立碁 1.6T 光收發模組進入送樣驗證。
summary.en: Jingcheng disclosed Q3 specialty gas shipments and glass via capacity plans, while Nan Pao reported semiconductor adhesive shipments. Economic Daily News reported customer sampling for Ligitek’s 1.6 Tbps optical module.

title.zh: 東南亞電子工廠投資與機房代管
title.en: Southeast Asian factory investment and colocation

summary.zh: 訊芯核准增資越南子公司 2,000 萬美元，GIS-KY 越南子公司公告機電工程契約。馬來西亞 YTL 表示柔佛機房代管服務不受美國遠端算力新規影響，個案尚無公開主管機關認定。
summary.en: ShunSin approved a US$20 million Vietnam equity injection and GIS-KY’s Vietnam subsidiary disclosed an electromechanical contract. Separately, Malaysia’s YTL said its Johor colocation business is unaffected by the new U.S. remote compute rule, with no public case-specific finding.

title.zh: 智慧製造工具機與腔體設備供應鏈
title.en: Smart manufacturing and semiconductor chamber tools

summary.zh: 經濟部 11 月 21 日說明智慧製造計畫近三年累計成果，其中國產五軸半導體腔體工具機已獲德國客戶 30 台訂單。政府估計約 4.5 億元相關產值，機台交付及驗收尚未公開。
summary.en: MOEA reported cumulative smart-manufacturing results, including 30 orders from a German customer for Taiwan-developed semiconductor chamber machine tools. Estimated production value is NT$450 million, with deliveries and acceptance undisclosed.
